name: MarketOwl
tagline: AI marketer that creates strategies and executes multi-channel marketing campaigns.
description: MarketOwl serves as an AI marketer designed for founders and marketing professionals. It analyzes business funnels to develop tailored ICP strategies and automates campaign execution across channels such as Reddit, X, LinkedIn, SEO, email, and paid advertising. Users can run prebuilt playbooks, connect thousands of external tools via API, monitor sprints, and retain approval control over all generated content and outreach initiatives.
pricing: Free trial with $50 in starting credits; credit top-ups and subscription options available after trial.
pros: Comes with $50 in free trial credits to test strategy and initial execution sprints
Integrates with over 8,000 marketing platforms and tools via API
Offers preconfigured marketing playbooks across multiple organic and paid channels
cons: Specific monthly subscription pricing tiers are not detailed on the homepage

name: BPM Finder
tagline: Analyze tempo and structure from reference audio to create original music briefs
description: BPM Finder analyzes uploaded audio directly in the browser to calculate tempo, musical key, meter, energy, waveform, and beat positions. It integrates audio recognition and an AI music agent that translates analyzed technical musical signals into structured, editable briefs for original music generation.
pricing: Free plan includes 20 starter credits; paid plans start at $10/month (billed annually) or $12/month for 3,600 credits.
pros: Performs tempo, key, meter, and beat detection locally in your browser
Translates reference audio analysis into editable music generation briefs
Provides a free tier with 20 starter credits without upfront payment
cons: Song identification depends on short audio samples and third-party catalog coverage

name: support@pawcinema.com
tagline: Turn pet photos into stylized AI portraits across dozens of art styles.
description: PawCinema generates custom digital pet portraits from single cat or dog photos. Users can choose from 36 distinct art directions, such as watercolor, oil painting, cel animation, embroidery, and pop art. First-time users can create one portrait for free with web preview access, while full-resolution downloads and additional generations are available through pay-as-you-go credit top-ups without a subscription.
pricing: 1 portrait free; credit top-ups start at US$5 (approx. 100 credits / $1.00 per generation).
pros: Includes 36 artistic styles spanning watercolor, oil paint, embroidery, and animation
No recurring subscription required; credits do not expire
Offers one free portrait creation for new users
cons: Original high-resolution downloads require a paid credit top-up
Supports only one pet per photo without human subjects
